summary: MaintDestinationCode manages creation, update, and validation of destination codes (such as those used for clinical placements or program sites), their associated contacts, and key attributes. It provides workflows to add, edit, activate, deactivate, and view detailed information and profiles tied to destination codes, ensuring data integrity and user access control.
purpose: To administer and maintain a master list of destination codes and their associated key data—names, short names, governing organizations, services, and designated contacts—for use in placement scheduling, reporting, and inter-organizational coordination.

workflows.name: Add/Edit DestinationCode
steps: User (with correct permissions) selects 'Add' or 'Edit' on the master list screen.
A modal/popup form is presented with required and optional fields.
If adding, the form defaults governing org and site based on context.
User must specify required fields (Name, ShortName, Service, DestinationContact, etc.).
Validators enforce data presence and format (e.g., phone, email, department if new contact is being added).
Upon 'Save', system checks if form is valid; if yes, DestinationCode is added/updated and list is refreshed.

workflows.name: Deactivate (Delete)/Reactivate DestinationCode
steps: User clicks delete/reactivate; system disables or re-enables the code.
System updates data, refreshes list, and ensures only allowed users may edit/reactivate.

workflows.name: View/Edit Destination Profile
steps: User clicks the profile icon; profile details for the selected DestinationCode are shown in a separate window (editable if permitted).

business_rules: Only users with proper permissions (SystemAdmin, LocalAdmin with appropriate context, PlacementCoordinator) can add/edit destination codes.
Users cannot edit codes in their own agency unless system administrator or receiving user.
ShortName must be unique and provided.
All codes must be linked to a governing org and service.
Inactive/retired codes can be reactivated, but renaming is prevented to maintain history.
validations: RequiredFieldValidator for Name, ShortName, Service, and for new DestinationContact: Department, FirstName, LastName, Phone.
CustomValidator checks that at least one of DestinationContact or Department is selected.
Phone, Fax, and Alternate Phone have area code and format validation using masked inputs.
Fields like Title, Designation have length validations.
conditions: If 'Add new' is selected in the contact dropdown, department and all contact fields become visible and required.
Edit controls are hidden or disabled if the user lacks proper permissions.
If DestinationContact is not selected, must provide department and contact details.
system_behavior: Conditional field display based on contact selection.
Auto-fills default area code where applicable.
Help links and tooltips provided for context-sensitive guidance.
Profile icons and tooltips change to reflect profile status.
dependencies: DestinationCode entries depend on GoverningOrg, Service, and optionally Department and Staff lists.
Staff/DestinationContact list is synchronized with active HSPnet users.
Dropdown data sources for organization, department, and service depend on agency/site context.
exceptions: If validation fails, the operation is halted and errors are displayed.
Non-unique short name or missing required fields prevent saving.
If no user privileges, edit and add controls remain hidden.
